summary: Implement dashboard password recovery using scoped Better Auth, existing transactional email and atomic reset/session revocation.
noAssistantImpact: Identity proof, reset tokens and passwords remain exclusively in deterministic authentication routes and UI. Recovery grants no membership or business authority and is excluded from assistant tools. No capability or procedure rows change.

evidence.result: 8 tests/68 assertions through installed Better Auth and Prisma adapter with inert persistence/transport: generic background request, hashed expiry, reset/new sign-in, replay, invalid/expired tokens, password bounds, rollback, origin/limits, provider failure and concurrent single consumption.
